description: Every Tennessean has the right to worship in peace – you should be able to do so without fear of intimidation, disruption, or violence.Unfortunately, we live in a time when these sacred spaces are increasingly under threat. Across the country, we have seen vandalism, harassment, and even deadly attacks targeting people at prayer.
